context: A retired exec mentors a younger boss about sensitive negotiations
purpose: Teach: 解約/非公開/算出/教職員/公安/国益/ディレクトリ/費やし

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 先輩、例の契約の解約の件でご相談したく、お時間を頂きました。
lines.en: Senpai, I wanted to consult you about cancelling that contract — thank you for your time.
lines.style: Deferential younger executive, measured and respectful tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ああ、構わんよ。あの案件は非公開で進めるのが筋だな。表に出せば厄介になる。
lines.en: Of course, no problem. That matter should be handled confidentially — it'd get messy if it leaked.
lines.style: Calm elder statesman, gravelly and assured delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 違約金を算出してみたのですが、想定の倍近い額になりまして…正直、頭を抱えています。
lines.en: I calculated the penalty fee and it came out nearly double our estimate — frankly, I'm at a loss.
lines.style: Anxious mid-career boss, slightly hesitant phrasing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 数字だけで動くな。相手方には教職員年金の絡みもある。地方の名士連中が黙っとらんぞ。
lines.en: Don't move on numbers alone. The other side has teacher pension ties — local notables won't stay quiet.
lines.style: Stern mentor voice with experienced warning tone behind every word.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: やはり…。実は公安からも軽く接触がありまして、扱いが難しいんです。
lines.en: I feared as much. Actually, public security made a quiet approach too — it's a delicate situation.
lines.style: Lowered voice, conspiratorial and uneasy throughout the exchange.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ならばこそ慎重にやれ。国益に絡む話なら、君一人で背負うべきじゃない。
lines.en: All the more reason to tread carefully. If national interest is involved, don't shoulder it alone.
lines.style: Grave advisory tone, deliberate pacing throughout the whole reply.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 資料は社内のディレクトリに全部まとめてあります。後でアクセス権をお渡ししますので。
lines.en: All the documents are organized in the internal directory — I'll grant you access afterward.
lines.style: Practical tone, slightly relieved to be sharing the burden.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 私も若い頃、似た案件に三年費やしたことがある。焦るな、勝ち筋は必ず見えてくる。
lines.en: When I was young, I spent three years on a similar case. Don't rush — a path to victory always emerges.
lines.style: Reflective elder voice, warm but firm reassurance throughout.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。先輩のお言葉、肝に銘じます。
lines.en: Thank you so much. I'll take your words deeply to heart.
lines.style: Sincere gratitude, bowed-head respectful tone throughout.
